source: /sys/firmware/devicetree/base on the device, dumped 2026-11-14 through adb over Wi-Fi (scripts of the dump: _unixnu/dump-fuxi-dt.sh). /sys/firmware/fdt itself is root-only on this stock build, so the properties were read file by file from the world-readable tree.
